Application.Calculate

End Function

Function Probe() As String
Application.Calculation = xlCalculationManual
Dim ws As Worksheet, cell As Range
Set ws = Worksheets.Add
ws.Range("A1").Value = 2
ws.Range("A2").Value = 3
ws.Range("B1:B2").Formula = "=MissingFunction()"
For Each cell In ws.Range("B1:D3")
Probe = Probe & "|" & cell.Address(False,False) & ":" & CStr(cell.Value2) & ":" & cell.Text & ":" & cell.Formula
Next cell
End Function
